items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was a lot of trouble and that's pretty much explained in Phil Evans' book.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah - two, three o'clock in the morning. And, they were delighted to see us and we'd go in there and sit in the corner - banjo, mellophone and cornet and play a few songs; of course, we got everything for nothing - you know. And, I did that many times and, then, of course, during that time, Bix had--- about in that time, the Wolverines left the Stockton Club. Now, I don't know why.
There was a lot of trouble and that's pretty much explained in Phil Evans' book.
